title: atlas-findings block
description: What a producer puts in the ```atlas-findings fenced block of a route output. This is input to the checker, not an emitted atlas-finding.v1 document, and the difference matters: a producer supplies neither finding_id (derived from the claim and scope), nor verdict, nor verification_method. Those are assigned by whatever checked the finding, so a producer cannot declare its own success.

severity_rationale.description: A severity without a reason is a number someone can quote back as though it were assessed.

evidence.description: What the finding CLAIMS about its sources, checked against the run's observations rather than copied from them.

claim_check.description: A condition that would refute this finding: the producer says how it could be wrong, and a deterministic checker decides whether it is. Absent means the claim itself is not checked and the verdict stays insufficient_evidence. The two outcomes are not symmetric — refutation needs one counterexample, while a condition that holds shows only that this condition held, not that it captures the claim.

kind.description: Literal text only. A producer-supplied regular expression is untrusted input that can hang the checker; a substring search cannot.

source_id.description: Must be a source this finding cites, and one the run read.

text.description: Empty would match everything and settle nothing.
